title: ExitZero
description: A team-built evacuation simulator with a floor-plan editor, live playback, and analytics. My work focuses on deterministic spawning, continuous navigation, collisions, and simulation metrics.

title: Email Sifting Agent
description: A desktop app that organizes Microsoft and Gmail inboxes with configurable rules. Supports background processing, progress reporting, cancellation, and an offline rule simulator.

title: Rocky Homework Platform
description: A team project for professor-managed classes and short-answer homework. Students submit answers, receive AI-generated scores and feedback, and review their submission history.

title: KSU VEX Robotics Website
description: A community website project for Kent State’s VEX Robotics club, built to showcase the team and help visitors find involvement and sponsorship information.

title: Spending-Saver
description: A spending analysis project that classifies purchases as essential or non-essential and presents daily spending waste, longer-term projections, and personalized insights.

title: AI Study
description: Experiments in AI and neural networks, including training on the Iris dataset to predict flower classes from measured features.

title: Portfolio
description: This personal portfolio showcases my projects, experience, and education with responsive layouts and animated backgrounds.
